cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, time, resource
def measure(name, req):
    data = json.dumps(req).encode()
    t0=time.time()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B','/workspace/submission/cli.py'],
                       input=data, capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
    dt=time.time()-t0
    ru=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
    ok = p.returncode==0 and p.stdout.startswith(b'{"runs":')
    print('%-34s %6.2fs in=%5.1fMB out=%5.1fMB rss=%4.0fMB %s' % (name, dt,
          len(data)/1e6, len(p.stdout)/1e6, ru.ru_maxrss/1024, 'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'))
    if not ok: print(p.stderr.decode()[-800:])

# single dequeue with n = 100000 (all idle)
measure('single-dequeue-100k', {"runs":[dict(banks=16, load_balancers=8,
    fifo_bytes=10, pifo_bytes=10, refill_batch=32, sample_period=1,
    borders=[0,1], policy={"kind":"fifo"}, events=[["dequeue",100000]])]})

# WFQ 10k flows x 60k enqueues
weights=[[i, 1+(i%1024)] for i in range(10000)]
measure('wfq-10k-60k', {"runs":[dict(banks=2, load_balancers=2,
    fifo_bytes=2**31-1, pifo_bytes=2**31-1, refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000,
    borders=[0,10**15], policy={"kind":"wfq","weights":weights},
    events=[["enqueue",i,i%10000,1000,0] for i in range(60000)])]})

# 100k enqueue events (beyond published 60k, robustness check)

    fifo_bytes=2**31-1, pifo_bytes=2**31-1, refill_batch=32, sample_period=100000,
    borders=[0,50000], policy={"kind":"sff"},
    events=[["enqueue",i,1,100,(i*7919)%100000] for i in range(100000)])]})

# 8 runs x 8 banks x 64 ranges, samples bounded

    runs.append(dict(banks=8, load_balancers=8, fifo_bytes=2**31-1, pifo_bytes=2**31-1,
